messages:
jordan_support: FYI — enterprise customer reported a sudden burst of 401s from our TS client after the cross-sdk regen yesterday. Billing spike because the app retried 3x. Repro steps and logs below.

jordan_support: Repro (minimal):
```
# using node 18, openapi-ts client v1.6.0
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gptx', input: 'hi' });
```

jordan_support: Server logs: `2024-12-05T14:02:11Z request_id=abc123 status=401 message="missing auth header"` then client shows `retrying request (1/3)` then successful 200 only after manual header set.

jordan_support: Customer claims they did not change anything locally. We suspect regen changed header handling or auth param names in TS generator. @mike_sdk can you triage?

mike_sdk: Thanks — can you paste the exact request headers the TS client shipped? are we sending `authorization` lower-case vs `Authorization`? any `x-api-key` variants? Also which retry strategy was used (sdk default)?

jordan_support: Got a capture from their dev — headers from client v1.6.0: `{ 'authorization': 'Token abc...', 'x-client-version': 'openapi-ts/1.6.0' }`. Server expects `Authorization: Bearer ...`. Their previous runtime used `Authorization: Bearer` and worked.

mike_sdk: Hmm. The regen PR changed the auth param name in the model from `apiKey` -> `token` and the codegen helper now emits raw value without `Bearer ` prefix unless you pass `bearer: true`. That sounds like a breaking change in the generator.

ci-bot: pipeline #3421 (cross-sdk-regen) completed at 2024-12-05T02:15Z — diff: openapi.yml auth scheme name changed from `ApiKeyAuth` -> `TokenAuth` (automated rename).

anna_devex: That rename was surfaced in the upstream spec update — but we intentionally expected codegen to preserve runtime compatibility. Looks like the generator mapping for TS dropped the `bearer` wrapper. We need a hotfix that injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` if scheme type is bearer-like.

lucy_ops: Customer also saw retries multiply requests (3x) — that explains billing surge. Is the retry logic tied to auth failures? We should short-circuit 401s for non-idempotent endpoints or at least avoid retrying on 401 by default.

mike_sdk: Agreed. Short-term plan: 1) publish patch 1.6.1 that restores previous header behavior (wrap with Bearer when env var style used) 2) change default retry policy to not retry on 4xx including 401 for POST/chat endpoints 3) add a regression test in regen CI that checks auth headers for each SDK.

kate_eng: I can cut the 1.6.1 patch now. Quick question: do we also need to notify Dedicated/Private customers re: spec drift? This was triggered by a spec rename in openapi.yml we pulled in via spec-sync.

jordan_support: Customer wants immediate workaround — they set header manually to `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and traffic normalized. Will ask them to upgrade once patch is out.

mike_sdk: Pushed branch `fix/ts-auth-bearer` with unit tests, will open PR in ~15m. Also adding `dont-retry-on-4xx` flag default.

ci-bot: opened PR #3489 — regen pipeline created. Tests: auth-header-check (TS) FAILED locally due to new generator change.

anna_devex: We'll also add an acceptance test: generate client from spec and assert header exactly equals `Authorization: Bearer`. That should catch these renames.

lucy_ops: Ops note: we should check logs for other customers around the regen window to identify any billing anomalies and offer credits if needed. I'll run a query for any +3x retry bursts between 2024-12-05T01:00 and 2024-12-05T03:00.

jordan_support: Thanks all. I'll coordinate comms with the customer and attach repro artifacts to the ticket. Will escalate billing to finance if we confirm a measurable spike. :thumbsup:

kate_eng: Patch released 1.6.1, rollback available if needed. Changelog: "fix: restore Authorization: Bearer behavior, disable retry on 4xx by default". Please prod-test and notify customer.

mike_sdk: After patch merge, will add a CI gate that rejects regenerations that change auth scheme name without an explicit compatibility note.

jordan_support: Closing loop — customer upgraded to 1.6.1 and confirmed no more 401s. Keeping ticket open for postmortem to document root cause (openapi rename + generator mapping) and action items.
